Fit diagnostics of a rating

Source: R/accessors.R
rating_diagnostics.Rd

How well each limb fits its gaugings and how the fit was found: error measures, the number of gaugings, multi-start and bootstrap bookkeeping, and whether an exponent sits on a bound.

Usage

rating_diagnostics(x)

Arguments

x

A FlodeRating or FlodeSegmentedRating. A FlodeRatingTable holds equations only and has no fit.

Value

A data.table, one row per limb for a FlodeRating and a single row for a FlodeSegmentedRating. For a FlodeRating: limb, rmse_cms (cumecs), rmse_pct, r_squared, n_obs, n_unique_stage, mean_error_cms, median_abs_error_cms, max_abs_error_cms, residual_df, n_starts_attempted, n_starts_converged, selected_start_id, near_bound, n_boot_requested, n_boot_success, n_boot_failed and boot_success_fraction; columns the fit did not produce are left out. For a FlodeSegmentedRating: n_segments, rmse_cms, r_squared, n_obs and the multi-start columns.

See also

rating_coefficients(), rating_support()

Examples

set.seed(1)
stage_m <- seq(0.5, 2.5, by = 0.05)
discharge_cms <- 5 * stage_m^1.6 + rnorm(length(stage_m), sd = 0.02)
fit <- rate_optimise(discharge_cms, stage_m)
rating_diagnostics(fit)
